reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Most powerful technology, ungoverned
themes.definition: Alarm that AI, the most powerful technology ever, has no one governing it, and that it is an ethical and geopolitical rather than merely technical issue.
themes.inclusion: Include statements that AI lacks governance or must be governed collectively as a political/ethical matter.
themes.exclusion: Exclude national regulatory choices described as domestic policy (AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY).
themes.boundary_cases: Framing AI as 'an ethical challenge' can also be coded AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS.

examples.quote: we're seeing the emergence of the most powerful technology that humankind has ever known, and no one is governing it
It is an ethical challenge and a geopolitical issue.

themes.label: Rejecting innovation-versus-responsibility dilemma
themes.definition: Positioning AI policy between fear and recklessness: neither rushing nor turning away from AI's opportunities, a 'responsible pace'.
themes.inclusion: Include passages that reject a trade-off between innovation and responsibility or describe balancing speed against capacity to manage.
themes.exclusion: Exclude purely promotional or purely alarmist statements.
themes.boundary_cases: Domestic regulatory balance described as 'responsible pace' also counts under AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY.

examples.quote: We reject the false dilemma between innovation and responsibility.
We want to lead from a position of knowledge and not fear.

themes.label: National AI growth and responsible pace
themes.definition: The speaker's own country's AI approach: expected growth gains, enabling regulation, investment in talent and energy.
themes.inclusion: Include descriptions of domestic AI regulation, investment and expected national growth.
themes.exclusion: Exclude generic global claims about AI's economic potential.
themes.boundary_cases: National food production projections enabled by AI may be coded AI_DEVELOPMENT_SDGS instead.

examples.quote: We have regulations that make things possible that do not hamper progress. We have investment in talent and in energy

themes.label: UN as forum on AI's fate
themes.definition: The UN presented as the place to bring humankind together to discuss AI.
themes.inclusion: Include claims that the UN must convene or lead discussion on AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude UN reform statements not linked to AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Contrasting slow UN reform with fast AI emergence counts only if the UN is assigned an AI role.

examples.quote: The United Nations must be able to bring humankind together to discuss a technology that will decide the fate of this century.

themes.label: AI as defining force of the era
themes.definition: AI framed as the defining transformation of the age, comparable to steam or the transistor, and embedded in decision-making across warfare, economy and daily life.
themes.inclusion: Include historical-epochal framings of AI as the driving force or great transformation of our time.
themes.exclusion: Exclude brief listings of AI among technologies without epochal framing (AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION).
themes.boundary_cases: Epochal framing followed by specific benefits should also be coded with the benefit theme.

examples.quote: Steam powered the industrial revolution. The transistor powered the digital age. No force in our time is as profound as artificial intelligence.

themes.label: AI multiplying food production
themes.definition: AI's potential to accelerate development, e.g. vastly expanding food production.
themes.inclusion: Include concrete claims of AI enabling development outcomes like food security or faster progress.
themes.exclusion: Exclude generic growth percentages for the national economy (AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY).
themes.boundary_cases: Inclusion demands ('no one should be left out') accompanying benefits may also be AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: Paraguay today feeds 100 million people, and with this tool, it could feed 1 billion.

value.rationale: Chile and Paraguay (2026) both treat AI as the era's decisive transformation within UN-reform arguments; Chile stresses ungoverned power, ethics and a responsible national pace, while Paraguay stresses epochal significance and development potential.
